how_to: Hand-made corrections to the open-data timetables. A train listed here replaces the one with the same number in timetables.json. Use station codes from route.json; the first stop needs dep, the last arr, the others both, as HH:MM. Say where the times came from in source. Then run python3 scraper/journey_build.py, which refuses a timetable that doesn't fit the route.
